3_funnel.question: Does NumPyro's NUTS show the neck under-coverage on Neal's funnel that the JMLR paper reports, while oWALNUTS v10 (fixed paper tuning and Appendix C adaptation) does not?

FN-F.role: fixed paper tuning (WP6 F50 configuration) on v10

FN-A.role: Appendix C adaptation, WP9 A2-R configuration (= paper-mode v3 defaults)

FN-N95.role: NumPyro NUTS with the usual funnel remedy (higher target acceptance)

estimands.primary: per cell and seed: P(omega < -5) and P(omega < -6) with the exact values, omega variance, divergences, retained refinement exhaustions / invalid stops, rank R-hat and bulk/tail ESS of omega and x_1, work (target calls / leapfrogs incl. warmup) and total sampling wall
estimands.bias_rule: a cell 'under-covers the neck' when P(omega < -5) < exact - 0.009 (i.e. outside the fix-gate tolerance on the low side); a cell 'passes' when every funnel gate holds

predictions.P7: FN-F and FN-A pass every funnel gate on 3/3 seeds
predictions.P8: FN-N80 under-covers the neck on >= 2/3 seeds and reports > 0 divergences on 3/3 seeds
predictions.P9: FN-N95 under-covers the neck on >= 2/3 seeds (less severely than FN-N80) and reports > 0 divergences on >= 2/3 seeds
predictions.P10: no NumPyro cell passes every funnel gate
